subject: Next steps: technical demo for Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Priya Banerjee <priya@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: technical demo for Acme Health

Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really valuable discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key needs: lower-latency patient note summarization, on-prem data controls for PHI, predictable throughput for nightly batch jobs.
- Success metrics discussed: <20ms median token latency for short queries, SOC2-compliant audit logs, and <10% overage on monthly token budget.

Next step: schedule a 45–60 minute technical deep-dive/demo where Camila (solutions engineer) can walk through integrations, perf expectations, and the private deployment options. Could you confirm who from your side should attend (engineering, security, infra)?

Proposed slots (PST):
- Thu Mar 11, 10:00–11:00am
- Thu Mar 11, 2:00–3:00pm
- Fri Mar 12, 9:00–10:00am

If none of those work, send a couple of alternatives and I’ll circulate a calendar invite. I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a pre-demo checklist so we can tailor the agenda.

Thanks,

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf

Subject: Re: Next steps: technical demo for Acme Health

Thanks Marissa — great call. Thu Mar 11 at 2pm PST works best for our team. Attendees from Acme: myself (product lead), Priya Banerjee (engineering manager), and optionally our infra lead (TBD). We may add one security engineer after we confirm the time.

Could you send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and include any pre-read? Also curious if Camila can cover on-prem deployment constraints (networking/KMS) in the demo.

Best,
Samir

Thanks Samir — confirmed for Thu Mar 11, 2:00–3:00pm PST. I’ve created a calendar invite and included a Zoom link below. Please accept when you have a moment.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=AcmeDemo
Google Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-demo-20270311

Attendees (confirmed):
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Camila Reyes (Solutions Engineer)
- Acme Health: Samir Patel (Product Lead), Priya Banerjee (Engineering Manager), possible infra/security (TBD)

Agenda (proposed):
1) 5 min intros / goals
2) 15–20 min architecture & integration approach (Camila)
3) 15 min performance & deployment options (dedicated vs private)
4) 10 min Q&A / next steps

Attached is a brief pre-demo checklist (pre-demo-checklist.pdf) and our discovery notes for your reference. If you want Camila to focus more on networking/KMS, let us know and we’ll prioritize that section.

Thanks and looking forward,
—Marissa

Hi Samir / Priya — looking forward to the demo today. I’ll cover integration patterns and deployment considerations. Quick notes / ask for attendees:

- Please include your infra or security engineer if possible — we’ll touch on networking (VPC peering, firewall rules) and KMS/HSM flows.
- I’ll bring a short slide on performance expectations and a checklist of required network ports.
- Attached a brief set of integration questions we like to have answered before deep-dive (integration-questions.docx). If you can fill or flag anything beforehand, that will help us focus the session.

See you at 2pm PST — joining on the Zoom link Marissa provided.
